watches.name: Pièce Unique (1 of 1): Höglund & Sons Mark V Prototype with Blue Dial
watches.description: NOTE: Only one Mark V with this dial was produced, making it a pièce unique. It will never be replicated in the future. From the Höglund & Sons Founder, Brandon Höglund: The Mark V represents our interpretation of the ideal three-hand watch. It combines the simplicity and thinness of a dress watch with the utility and versatility of a sports watch. It is the culmination of all the knowledge my brother and I have accrued from our five previous successful Kickstarter campaigns and the hundreds of watches we have reviewed on our YouTube channel WatchesOnYou . The Movement We investigated several movement options for this watch, and it became clear that the reliability and functionality of the Miyota 9039 movement was ideal for the Mark V due to its: Ultra-Smooth 4 Hz (8 "ticks" per second) second hand. Ability to be wound using the motion of the wearer's wrist. Premium Finishing with Geneva Stripes. 42 hour power reserve (without any wrist winding). Hacking/Stopping-seconds feature, which allows for more precise time setting by stopping the motion of the seconds hand while the minute and hour hands are being set. Extensive track record of reliability. The Case The case of the Mark V is milled from stainless steel and features scratch-resistant sapphire front and caseback crystals. The case has a diameter of 38 mm, a lug-width of 19 mm, a lug-to-lug length of 46 mm, and a thickness of 10.45 mm. The case features scalloped lugs, which add an element of texture to the sides of the case. The watch has a 50 m water resistance rating and each watch is individually tested to this depth prior to shipment. All watches will include both a genuine leather pin buckle strap and a steel mesh bracelet which can be exchanged without a spring bar tool using a spring-loaded pin system. Standard spring bars can also be used with the watch if a customer wants to use a custom strap. The crown is signed with an "H." The Dial All dial colors have an enamel-like glossy finish. All hour indices are applied rather than painted. Technical Specifications Case stainless steel sapphire front and caseback crystals 38 mm diameter 19 mm lug width 46 mm lug-to-lug length 10.45 mm thickness 50 m water resistance Dial five color options: black, gray, white, green, and blue applied hour indices glossy finish Movement Miyota 9039 Automatic Movement 42 hour power reserve frequency/vibrations per hour: 28,800 vibrations per hour 24 jewels hack-/stop-seconds feature Shipping & Tariffs Shipping is free worldwide. The watches will be shipped by the United States Postal Service and its international partners. The watches ship from the United States and there will be no customs duties charged for buyers in the United States. For buyers outside the United States, customs fees will be assessed and charged by each individual country's customs authorities. It is the responsibility of these buyers to pay the duties. Once a watch is shipped and it arrives in a buyer's home country, that country's customs authorities will contact the buyer directly and request payment of any fees from them. We have extensive experience with international shipping and will offer assistance to international buyers who may need it. Warranty Our watches come with a one year warranty covering the movement and movement-related issues. Like with our previous models, customers are encouraged to contact us with these issues and any other issues such that we can reach a satisfactory solution.

watches.name: Mark III GMT Aventurine
watches.description: The Mark III GMT Aventurine represents the culmination of all that my brother Zachary and I have learned from our multiple previous successful Kickstarter campaigns, hundreds of watch reviews on our WatchesOnYou YouTube channel, and an immense amount of customer feedback and requests. With this model, we sought to approach a new complication for Höglund & Sons, the GMT (second time zone), with the combination of functionality and discretion that the brand has come to be known for. The Movement We investigated several movement options for this watch, and it became clear that the reliability and functionality of the Seiko NH34 movement was ideal for the Mark III due to its: GMT and date functionality. Ability to be wound using the motion of the wearer's wrist. 41 hour power reserve (without any wrist winding). Hacking/Stopping-seconds feature, which allows for more precise time setting by stopping the motion of the seconds hand while the minute, hour, and GMT hands are being set. Extensive track record of reliability. The Case The case of the Mark III GMT is milled from stainless steel and features scratch-resistant sapphire front and caseback crystals. The case has a diameter of 38 mm, a lug-width of 19 mm, a lug-to-lug length of 45 mm, and a thickness of 12.75 mm. The caseback features a laser-engraved timezone scale, which is helpful for setting the second timezone function. This is also a tribute to the first Höglund and Sons model which had the same feature and features Minneapolis in bold in place of Chicago to honor our hometown. The watch has a 100 m water resistance rating and each watch is individually tested to this depth prior to shipment. All watches will include both a leather pin buckle strap and a steel mesh bracelet. The crown is signed with an "H." The Dial The watch features Swiss Super-Luminova on all hands and indices, offering a significant improvement from previous Höglund & Sons models. All hour indices are applied rather than painted and the dial is constructed from aventurine glass, which creates an effect resembling the night sky. Technical Specifications Case stainless steel sapphire front and caseback crystals 38 mm diameter 19 mm lug width 45 mm lug-to-lug length 12.75 mm thickness 100 m water resistance timezone scale on caseback Dial applied hour indices aventurine glass with glossy finish Swiss Super-Luminova lume Movement Seiko NH34 automatic GMT movement 41 hour power reserve frequency/vibrations per hour: 21,600 bph 24 jewels hack-/stop-seconds feature Warranty Our watches come with a 1 year warranty covering the movement and movement-related issues. Like with our previous models, customers are encouraged to contact us with these issues and any other issues such that we can reach a satisfactory solution. Shipping We ship anywhere in the world via USPS first class mail. Shipping is free within the United States and $15.00 per watch elsewhere. Tariffs All watches ship from the United States and there are no tariff costs for United States buyers. For international buyers, tariffs are determined by their local country and will be collected by their local customs department. Need Help? Click here and submit a form. We will respond within 24 hours. Return Policy Our watches come with a 60 day return policy with the buyer paying return shipping. Products must be returned in their original condition and packaging.
